nodes.name: Sklearn Gaussian Process Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level GaussianProcessRegressor and GaussianProcessClassifier estimator-selection, optimizer-boundary, callback-payload, and fitted-state atoms above kernel optimization, Cholesky/posterior algebra, Laplace posterior-mode, multiclass, prediction, and sampling execution.

nodes.name: gp_public_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public Gaussian-process estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: gp_public_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return whether a public Gaussian-process estimator is a regressor or classifier.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: gp_public_optimizer_boundary
nodes.description: Return the no-optimizer, built-in L-BFGS-B, or callable optimizer boundary selected by a public Gaussian-process estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed optimizer boundary categories.

nodes.name: gp_public_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level Gaussian-process routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered Gaussian-process estimator.

nodes.name: gp_public_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public Gaussian-process fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing kernel optimization, Cholesky solves, Laplace loops, or multiclass callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without fitting the Gaussian-process estimator.

nodes.name: gp_public_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public Gaussian-process prediction-like payload without executing posterior prediction, probability, or sampling callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object, return_std: bool = False, return_cov: bool = False, n_samples: int = 1, random_state: int | None = 0) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving posterior prediction or sampling to sklearn.

nodes.name: gp_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public Gaussian-process estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: gp_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted kernel, optimizer, marginal-likelihood, feature, train-shape, posterior-shape, class, and multiclass metadata after deferred Gaussian-process execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes already-fitted class labels and shape metadata without recomputing kernel or posterior algebra.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 2 and Case 4 public Gaussian-process estimator shells over kernel optimization, Cholesky/posterior algebra, Laplace posterior-mode, multiclass, prediction, and sampling boundaries
limitations: Kernel construction and mutation, L-BFGS-B or callable optimization, Cholesky solves, posterior algebra, Laplace posterior-mode loops, multiclass meta-estimator orchestration, prediction, probability, sampling, scoring, and log-marginal-likelihood evaluation remain delegated behavior.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not Gaussian-process training or posterior inference execution.
